subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff: party data, template alignment, and risk notes
messages:
From: Andre Soto <andre.soto@acme.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff: party details and timelines

Hi Sofia / Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — excited to get the contracting process started so we can align on timeline for a Q4 launch. Attached is our (redlined) MSA and a draft order form that shows expected seat counts and billing cadence. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirm Redwood's standard indemnity and data-processing language; our legal team will flag anything outside of that as critical.
- Confirm billing contact and PO process — we generally need net-45 and a PO reference.
- SOC 2 / security evidence: can you share certificate and an evidence package pointer?

Tentative timeline: we'd like to have counters by Sep 8 so procurement can review before their Sep 15 board meeting. Is that feasible?

Attachments: Acme_MSA_Redline_v1.pdf (pdf), Acme_OrderForm_Draft.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Andre Soto
Sr. Director, Partnerships
Acme Analytics, Inc.
andre.soto@acme.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Andre Soto <andre.soto@acme.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff: party details and timelines

Hi Andre — thanks for the materials and the clear timeline. Looping in Kimberly (contracts lead) and Markus (billing/comms) to pick up redline review and billing items. Quick confirmation below and next steps: 

- Timeline: we'll aim to return a counter-redline by Wed Sep 2 to keep you on track for Sep 8 internal review. If we need more time we'll flag Monday Sep 6.
- Billing: Markus, can you confirm net-45 feasibility and PO flow for Acme?
- Security evidence: Kimberly, can you pack the SOC 2 cert + evidence link; Andre, we’ll provide a short evidence bundle (cert + control summary) and a list of what we cannot share (if any).

We'll also run the Acme MSA against our template and supply a change log that highlights any non-standard commercial or IP clauses to speed review on both sides.

Action items:
- Kimberly: intake redlines, prepare change-log (by Mon Aug 31)
- Markus: confirm billing cadence and billing contact (by Mon Aug 31)
- Sofia: schedule a 30-min sync for Tue Sep 1 to review major redline points (proposal: 10:00 AM PT)

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Contracts (Americas)
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Acme intake — initial redline highlights

Sofia / Markus — I pulled the attached Acme redline into our review tracker and flagged the following items as high-priority for discussion with the customer: 

1) Liability cap: Acme has removed the cap for certain data-related claims; recommend we hold firm to template cap (liability limited to greater of $X or 12 months fees).
2) Indemnity carveouts: Acme attempts to broaden their indemnity for third-party claims — flag for legal.
3) Data processing: they propose a shorter retention limit (30 days) and preclude certain telemetry collection; need Product input on impact.
4) Termination for convenience: order form proposes 30-day termination with pro-rated credits — commercial to assess.

I'll prepare a clean counter that: (a) maps each change to our template clause; (b) includes a bullet rationale for negotiation priority. Expect the change-log and draft counter in the Drive folder below by Mon Aug 31 EOD.

Attachments referenced: redwood-msa-template-v3.docx (docx)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeOnboarding

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Andre Soto <andre.soto@acme.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 14:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff: party details and timelines

Thanks — that sounds good.

Two quick clarifications from our procurement side: 
- PO: we can do net-45 but will need a billing contact who can accept a PO and invoice matching (please provide contact + remit address).
- SOC 2: our security team needs the cert and a basic evidence index; can you share a short pack, and note any items that require an NDA before sharing?

If you can get the counter by Sep 2 that will keep us on track. Also fine with Tue Sep 1 10:00 AM PT for a 30-min sync — please send an invite.

Best regards,
Andre
